Li Yinghong (DJ Didilong) Portrait

A close‑up shot captures Li Yinghong’s intense gaze, with tousled black hair and layered silver necklaces accenting his modern streetwear look. The neutral gray backdrop and soft lighting highlight his sharp features and understated style.

This portrait illustrates the rapper’s persona as DJ Didilong, known for his song “台北直直撞,” which fuses rap with new Taiwanese folk influences. Featured in a COOL‑STYLE article on hip‑hop artists’ passion for motorbikes, the image underscores his decade‑long career revival and strong ties to two‑wheel culture.

sources.title: 李英宏睽違五年推出專輯《東方美人》，以黑色電影為靈感打造台式浪漫情歌 | Vogue Taiwan
sources.description:
未來感側臉特寫

一位年輕男子的側臉在柔和淺藍色背景前顯得格外立體，髮絲微捲，皮膚光滑，神情專注地凝視前方。多條銀色電線般的裝置從畫面上方垂下，金屬光澤在冷色調光線中閃爍，與人物輪廓形成強烈對比。

畫面以簡潔構圖呈現未來感與神秘氛圍，人物與裝置之間的張力呼應了專輯《東方美人》所追求的黑色電影美學與東方風情。這張形象照同時展現了李英宏在視覺與音樂上的跨界創作精神。
